purpose: Memory Loop illustrated card atlases. Four columns by three rows; no emoji.

assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a production sprite atlas for a premium illustrated memory matching card game. Make one landscape image, exactly FOUR equal columns and THREE equal rows, twelve equal square cells edge to edge, with each cell containing ONE beautifully illustrated collectible object centered. All cells have the SAME solid deep midnight teal background (#102c35), no lines, no frames, no letters, no words, no labels, no UI. Each object fully contained within middle 70% of its cell with generous equal padding, no crossing boundaries. Rich tactile hand-painted 3D storybook style, luxurious saturated colors, soft studio light from upper left, beautiful fine details, clean highly readable silhouettes. They must look like exquisite little illustrated sculptures, NOT flat icons, NOT emoji, NOT simple geometric shapes. Each subject completely different and recognizable at small card size. Exact 4 by 3 grid and row order are essential. Row 1 left to right: red spotted woodland mushroom; brass compass with blue needle; orange fox curled with fluffy tail; glowing amber camping lantern. Row 2: blue butterfly with patterned wings; old turquoise camera with a big glass lens; strawberry with leaves; seashell with pearlescent pink ridges. Row 3: green frog sitting; purple crystal cluster; yellow vintage biplane; leafy bonsai tree in terracotta pot.
